title: NK 6624 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK 6624 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK 6624 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. 104 to 106 days to harvest, 7.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK 6624 corn is a yellow hybrid corn variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2006 as NSIC 2006 Cn 179. Syngenta bred it. It takes 104 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

items: **Days to harvest:** 104 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain.
**Yield:** 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.
**Recommended for:** Mindanao, in the dry season.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK 6624 corn takes 104 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 215 yellow hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 103.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 7.08 t/ha matches the average of its group, 7.17. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up
Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 16.1 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 78 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
Where and when to plant NK 6624 corn

The registry recommends it for Mindanao in the dry season. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 104 to 106 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 7.08 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Mindanao in the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK 6624?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
